messages:
ana (Partnerships): 🚀 Heads up — Solara Health just signed a 3-month Dedicated pilot and will publish a Redwood-backed integration in the HealthTech Marketplace next week. They validated VPC Private deployment and HIPAA controls. :tada:
sam (AE): Amazing! ETA on go-live for the marketplace listing? do we have a logo + short blurb from them?
jeff (Solutions Eng): Tech note: they're running our SDK + quantized model variant, targeting p95 latency <120ms on 8k context. I validated KV cache config with their infra team earlier. Need to confirm model pin and fallback policy.
maya (CSM): I'll own onboarding. Scheduled kickoff Wed 10am PT with Solara's infra and security leads. I'll push the welcome plan and runbook after the call.
elaine (Marketing): Love this! Can we get a customer quote for the announcement? who can shadow the kickoff for a quick case study interview? @maya or @ana? :memo:
tariq (Legal): Quick reminder — marketplace listing requires approved logo + signed plug-in terms. @sam please confirm the latest MSA addendum is countersigned before publishing.
integrations-bot: NOTE: marketplace package validation queued (job #8842). Expected artifacts: logo.svg, deployment-guide.pdf, security-summary.txt
ana (Partnerships): small correction — it's Ana (sorry for typo) :)
ana (Partnerships): @jeff can you confirm the model variant name so I can include it in the listing metadata?
jeff (Solutions Eng): Variant: redwood/gpt-optimized-v1-q4_0. Also recommend enabling prefix cache for their triage flows. I'll attach a short config snippet after the kickoff.
sam (AE): I'll get the logo and approval from the customer today and ping @tariq for countersign.
maya (CSM): I'll be on the record for the case interview. Elaine — can you draft 3 Qs? I can prep Solara's answers beforehand.
elaine (Marketing): Yes — will draft and share by EOD. planning a brief blog + marketplace banner.
ana (Partnerships): action items: sam = logo + contract, jeff = model metadata + config snippet, maya = kickoff + onboarding runbook, elaine = comms draft. tagging in spreadsheet: https://redwood.ai/partner-tracker/SOLARA-123 :point_right:
sam (AE): noted. congrats team :confetti_ball:
